method: Read-only audit; no database connection, migration, file ingestion or container mutation.

Then manual, large original, events, projected vector, MVT, semantic, sufficiency, streaming vector,
chunk mapping and streamed profile; then guarded packet plans, cards, PDF checkpoints and revocations.
Each helper sends its named sql(id) in one client.query; large original sends schema and capacity.
No ingestion helper records an applied marker.

answer: Existing sources, cases and jobs; self-reference and later references within the four new tables.
PostGIS geometry and functions are required for usp_holding_extent at lines 75-76.
Core creates cases, sources and jobs at database/sql/01-core/core.sql:3,15,51.
infrastructure/db.ts:176-183 runs core before registry, areas, officer, officer AI, spatial ML and USP.
No preceding ingestion helper is a ledger SQL dependency; bootstrap must have established PostGIS.
If cleared to continue, after migrateStreamedProfileTx at migrations.ts:36 is a valid insertion point.
Fully read: four CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and five CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS statements.
No ALTER, UPDATE, INSERT or DELETE. A second successful run skips all nine existing objects.
This is schema/data no-op repeatability, not a claim of zero locks or drift reconciliation.
Manifest lines 2610-2618 specify always, additive IF NOT EXISTS, one query call, USP scope and usp.lock.
scripts/migrate.ts:1-10 calls migrate and bucket setup; it is not a universal applied-step ledger.
USP records markers only for guarded blocks; intake relies on statement repeatability.
First creation installs foreign keys to sources, cases and jobs, taking SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE locks
on those existing referenced tables. This also occurs when they contain rows; it blocks writers
and is held until the enclosing USP migration transaction ends. No existing row is rewritten.
Population and lock duration were not measured; no connection to a populated runtime was made.
Allowlist admits authored SQL provenance, not runtime tables or execution permission.
Requires source.path = database/ + step.file, allowed source.task, and 40-hex acceptedBase.
K4a and K5 are admitted at line 133. Ledger manifest source.task is IN1, not IN2
(database/manifest.json:2600-2606); adding IN2 alone would not fix the refusal.
Requires exact SQL file bytes, batch SHA-256, per-statement hashes, contiguous manifest order,
unique step IDs/files, complete SQL file coverage and one named loader query in its runtime file.
It does not trace migration-helper reachability; a separate migration call test is necessary.
No separate table inventory, expected-objects file or runtime receipt is an input to this checker.
Runtime relation expectations derive from manifest SQL in infrastructure/database-readiness.ts:10-26.
The existing manifest already supplies the four-table ledger inventory and hashes at lines 2600-2660.
A real-run receipt is required by this task, not by verify_extraction.py; none is claimed here.

answer: Studio parses JSON and calls reduceFrame, not the strict shared change schema.
Valid unknown change kind advances sequence/cursor. An intake.item without sourceId returns next
at events.ts:55; no drawing, metrics, refresh increment or disconnect follows.
Malformed envelope/sequence throws at events.ts:17-18,43-44 and closes to polling in
useTableStream.ts:48-50; that is not unknown-kind rejection.
No ingestion SSE runtime consumer was found under packages/api-client/src; its schema is generated.
No Studio reader edit is needed for the requested additive kind.
Registration, probe publication and pin use transaction callbacks. Registration emits no event.
Probe success and pin call notifyTx, emitting only source.retained for needs_input sources.
Future intake.item must take values from rows in those write transactions, including probe failures.

controller.answer: IngestionController.retain handles POST cases/:caseId/sources for geojson, csv and xlsx.

answer: multipartBody first array marks required fields; properties declares optional fields too
(apps/api/src/modules/intake/wire-schemas.ts:319-323). Provenance is not in either declaration.
GeoParquet declares its lineage/selection and validates its own allowed field set; it is read-only here.
issuer, licence and containsPersonalData are absent from allowed fields and forwarding object.
Supplying any currently returns 422 INVALID_INPUT before service; omitting them loses stated provenance.
Absent fields must remain absent, and origin must not become an accepted multipart field.
Service parses AnyRetainSourceSchema. issuer is nonblank text up to 500 characters or null;
licence is unconfirmed|open|restricted; containsPersonalData is unknown|yes|no.
licence public is invalid. Existing Zod error response is 422 INVALID_INPUT
(apps/api/src/common/api-exception.filter.ts:23-26).

stopRule.reason: Foreign-key creation locks existing referenced tables, including if populated.
stopRule.action: Stop after Step 0; no production, contract, verifier or SQL changes; no runtime migration.
stopRule.next: Lead must explicitly clear the referenced-table lock before wiring, or commission an owned SQL redesign.
